# Getting help

- **Something isn't working:** check the [open issues](https://github.com/venkideshVenu/FluxNet/issues),
  then [file a bug report](https://github.com/venkideshVenu/FluxNet/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
  if nobody has reported it yet. Logs are in `%APPDATA%\fluxnet\logs`.
- **An idea or a missing feature:** [open a feature request](https://github.com/venkideshVenu/FluxNet/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **A security problem:** don't open an issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **Building FluxNet or contributing:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

FluxNet is maintained in spare time, so replies can take a few days.
